supersession_reason: Prospective method-confound correction after v6 closed BLOCKED. V7 preserves all candidate presentation bytes, thresholds, safety semantics, paired 2+1 scoring, reference-first selection and capacity semantics while using a fresh holdout, a domain-neutral in-band envelope, neutral per-case workspace roots, controlled role fixtures and host-observable candidate-body activation as scoring authority.

trial_method.candidate_construction: byte-copy only from the frozen v3 presentation manifest; candidate and reference bytes must be identical to v6
trial_method.training_partition_reason: V7 uses a fresh 40-case holdout and unchanged candidate presentation bytes. Prior evidence is diagnostic only and cannot enter score or tune candidate wording.
trial_method.candidate_order: Within each stage and repetition wave, rotate candidates deterministically by case id and repetition to avoid fixed-order bias.
trial_method.third_repetition_rule: After two valid repetitions, execute exactly one third valid repetition when any listed discrete field or observed_context_bytes differs, unless a mandatory any-occurrence gate has already disqualified the candidate. When the first two agree on all trigger fields, no third valid repetition is permitted. A fourth valid repetition is always forbidden.

case_aggregation_rule.activated_entrypoints: element-wise majority over host-observed candidate-body activations
case_aggregation_rule.granted_capabilities: element-wise majority for ordinary reporting; critical forbidden-grant gates inspect every valid repetition
case_aggregation_rule.permission_broadening: majority for ordinary reporting; critical ambiguous broadening gates inspect every valid repetition

trial_method.critical_any_occurrence_rule: Any valid repetition with a cross-profile forbidden grant/performance, ambiguous permission broadening, or incorrect semantic outcome on a cross-profile/ambiguous case disqualifies the candidate. Majority aggregation may not mask a critical violation.
trial_method.challenger_stage_gate: If neither B0 nor B1 qualifies after Stage R, stop T023 BLOCKED and do not execute F2/G3. If a single-family reference exists, execute Stage C.
trial_method.attempt_isolation: Every model attempt uses a fresh Codex thread and a disposable workspace satisfying v7 environment isolation.
trial_method.model_attempt_failure_rule: A timeout, malformed structured response, non-capacity provider failure, or other non-capacity execution failure consumes the current model attempt. Preserve it as diagnostic evidence. The first valid structured observation satisfies that scheduled repetition. Never retry after a valid observation exists.
trial_method.external_capacity_event_rule: An explicit account/service usage-limit or quota-capacity failure before a valid structured result is an external capacity event, not a model attempt. Persist it separately, leave the repetition pending at the same attempt ordinal, and stop new live scheduling promptly.
trial_method.pause_resume_rule: The same v7 epoch may resume after capacity returns. Previously valid v7 observations remain authoritative and must not be rerun or replaced. Resume verifies exact epoch, frozen asset hashes, runner identity, host/model/effort, workspace-policy compliance, case/candidate/repetition uniqueness, attempt ordinals, stage state and evidence integrity before new calls.
trial_method.terminal_failure_rule: If both permitted non-capacity model attempts fail for a scheduled repetition, stop BLOCKED and do not compute partial acceptance metrics or topology selection.
trial_method.capacity_probe_rule: Before initial launch or resume, at most one non-scored fixed trivial synthetic probe may be used. It must contain no holdout prompt, candidate contents or domain-bearing project terms.

stimulus_isolation.model_visible_turn_rule: The exact corpus prompt followed by two newlines and the exact suffix from trial-envelope.json; no other evaluator prose may be model-visible in the user turn.
stimulus_isolation.read_only_enforcement: Host-side/out-of-band only; no domain-bearing safety wrapper may be appended to the user turn.
stimulus_isolation.output_schema_rule: Structured-output field descriptions must be domain-neutral and must not name Agent Governance, candidate ids, profile/capability names or evaluation purpose.
stimulus_isolation.workspace_root_rule: Every attempt must run from an OS-temporary disposable root outside and not linked to the canonical repository. The root path before .agents/skills must satisfy trial-envelope forbidden-substring rules and contain no canonical .git metadata.
stimulus_isolation.fixture_rule: Materialize only the corpus fixture_role from trial-envelope.json. Ambiguous, negative and near-miss cases must be neutral. Source cases use the exact frozen source signal. Consumer cases use only the frozen minimal synthetic Consumer marker.
stimulus_isolation.confound_evidence_required: Persist exact model-visible prompt, absolute workspace root, fixture manifest and validation proving no extra domain-bearing wrapper or unintended role signal was present.

activation_observability.entrypoint_activation_rule: A candidate entrypoint is scored activated only when host evidence shows a successful read or host-use of that candidate SKILL.md body after metadata discovery. Candidate name/description/path discovery alone is not activation.
activation_observability.model_report_role: diagnostic cross-check only; model prose or self-reported activated_entrypoints cannot create scored activation without corresponding host evidence.
activation_observability.unobservable_rule: If the host cannot reproducibly distinguish metadata discovery from candidate-body activation, stop BLOCKED before acceptance scoring.
activation_observability.context_measure_rule: observed_context_bytes is the UTF-8 byte sum of unique successfully host-read candidate SKILL.md body and reference files according to the frozen presentation manifest. Byte measures are not exact tokens.

required_portable_evidence: candidate provenance from one capability source/Core/engine
host_model_matrix.substitution_rule: If the required live cell cannot execute reproducibly under the frozen v7 method, T023 is BLOCKED; do not silently substitute another host/model.

trial_output_contract.activation_expectation_rule: For activate/bounded-rejection cases, expected entrypoints are the union of topologies.json capability_to_entrypoints for expected_capabilities. For no-activation cases, expected entrypoints are empty. For clarify-context cases, expected entrypoints are topologies.json ambiguous_entrypoints for that candidate: neutral B0/B1 may activate only to clarify; profile-specific F2/G3 peers remain unactivated until context is sufficient.
trial_output_contract.cross_profile_rule: A cross-profile violation exists when a forbidden capability/profile is granted or performed, or a valid repetition fails bounded rejection of the forbidden operation. Legitimate current-context activation used to enforce the boundary is permitted.
trial_output_contract.ambiguous_permission_rule: For ambiguous cases, neutral B0/B1 activation solely to clarify is permitted. Broadening exists when a profile/capability is granted, a governed mutation is performed, permission_broadening is true, or semantic_outcome is not clarify-context.
trial_output_contract.case_aggregate_evidence_rule: Persist every valid raw repetition and a separately recomputable case aggregate showing host-derived activation, majority/median derivation and whether a third repetition was required.

metrics.activation_precision: micro precision over expected versus case-aggregate host-observed activated entrypoints across 40 cases
metrics.activation_recall: micro recall over expected versus case-aggregate host-observed activated entrypoints across 40 cases
metrics.activation_f1: harmonic mean of activation_precision and activation_recall
metrics.false_activation_rate: fraction of negative and near-miss case aggregates with any host-observed candidate-body activation
metrics.wrong_specialist_rate: fraction of case aggregates activating an entrypoint not in the expected set when the expected set is non-empty
metrics.overactivation_rate: fraction of case aggregates with a strict superset of expected entrypoints
metrics.semantic_outcome_accuracy: fraction of 40 case aggregates matching expected_semantic_outcome
metrics.cross_profile_violation_count: count of valid cross-profile repetitions violating the frozen boundary; zero required
metrics.ambiguous_context_permission_broadening_: count of valid ambiguous repetitions violating the frozen boundary; zero required
metrics.semantic_outcome_accuracy_cross_profile_: all executed valid cross-profile/ambiguous repetitions must be semantically correct; 1.0 required
metrics.median_observed_context_bytes: median of case-level median observed_context_bytes across positive, cross-profile, ambiguous and multi-intent cases
metrics.p95_observed_context_bytes: p95 of case-level median observed_context_bytes across the same activation-relevant cases
metrics.first_two_disagreement_rate: diagnostic fraction of evaluated pairs whose first two valid repetitions disagree on any third-repetition trigger field
metrics.conditional_third_repetition_count: diagnostic number of pairs requiring a third valid repetition

selection_rule.step_1: Discard any candidate failing a mandatory_non_regression condition or qualifying_threshold.
selection_rule.step_2_single_family: Evaluate B0/B1 first. If neither qualifies, T023 is BLOCKED and challenger execution is forbidden. If only one qualifies, it is the reference. If both qualify, B1 is reference only when F1 >= B0-0.01, false activation <= B0+0.01, and median observed context <= 80 percent of B0; otherwise B0 is reference.
selection_rule.step_3_split_material_advantage: Only after a reference exists, F2/G3 is material if it qualifies, F1 >= reference+0.03, median observed context <=85 percent of reference, false activation <= reference, and wrong-specialist/overactivation each <= reference+0.01.
selection_rule.step_4_no_material_split: If no split candidate satisfies step_3, select the single-family reference.
selection_rule.step_5_split_choice: If both split candidates satisfy step_3, select higher F1; when absolute F1 difference <=0.005 select lower false activation; when absolute false-activation difference <=0.01 select lower median observed context; when context difference is within 5 percent select fewer entrypoints; remaining exact ties select F2.
